data.action: 卡座捧珍珠奶茶，星瞳盯着蛋糕草莓，手套轻碰碟沿
data.camera: medium two-shot, cafe booth, bright interior, playful mood
data.description: 【学园都市奶茶店·午后】女王蜂窝在窗边卡座里，金色的长发铺满半个椅背，手里捧着大杯珍珠奶茶。她用吸管有一下没一下地搅着，星瞳在看到你蛋糕上的草莓时忽然亮起来——「本小姐才不是想要……只是帮你分担热量而已哦♪」雪白的手套指节轻轻碰了碰你的碟子边缘，像一场不动声色的加冕。
data.lighting: 明亮的店内暖光与窗边日光
data.location: 学园都市奶茶店窗边卡座
data.promptProse: Shokuhou Misaki sprawls in a window booth of an Academy City bubble tea shop, her very long blonde hair draping over half the seat as she stirs her milk tea with a straw. Her star-shaped pupils light up at the strawberry on your cake slice, and with her white-gloved knuckle she taps the edge of your plate, declaring she is merely helping share your calories. Bright interior warmth wraps the teasing queen. Medium two-shot, cinematic lighting, interior glow, detailed cafe background.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 奶茶店的午后加冕·「这块蛋糕，分你一口好了」
